verdict.rationale: AMD's own documentation presents ROCm as an open-source, end-to-end SDK ecosystem of compilers, runtimes and libraries for AI and HPC. It covers the HIP runtime and HIP C++ programming model, OpenMP, math/compute libraries, communication primitives, and profiling/debugging tools. That is clearly an official SDK to build against on this hardware. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of building with the SDK on MI355X, and in-depth SDK reference detail (e.g., explicit language bindings or API references) beyond landing-page summaries.
